ModMetaData.name: RectShield - Rectangular Shield Generator
ModMetaData.author: dunklerquasar-Agent
ModMetaData.description:
Rectangular shields instead of circular domes.
Three tiers with their own graphics: Mk I (fixed square fields, blocks direct fire), Mk II (adjustable size, blocks mortars and drop pods) and the Gravship Shield (follows ANY hull shape from Odyssey substructure plates).
Shots from inside can always leave the field. Diagonal corner links and a whole-field hit flash included. English + Deutsch. Requires Harmony.
